tools.name: get_salon_info
tools.description: Address (English and Thai for taxi drivers), map links, opening hours, phone/WhatsApp/Telegram, languages spoken and booking options of ERA in Bang Tao, Phuket.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Search ERA services with current prices in THB, durations and master levels (ONE / PRO / PRIME). Use q for keywords in any language (e.g. "gel manicure", "балаяж", "beard").

tools.name: find_available_slots
tools.description: Live free start times from the salon calendar for one or more services, optionally with a specific master (staff_id). Returns dates with times (Asia/Bangkok) and masters who do the service.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a real appointment in the salon calendar. ONLY call after the user explicitly confirmed: services, master (or any), date and time, their name and phone. The salon may contact the client to confirm.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: A link where the user can complete booking themselves, with the service and master preselected.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ERA services, prices and salon information. Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full details for an id returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
